transcript: Canonically serialize the proposal artifact exactly as given using JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace to produce proposal_canon.json (persist the exact bytes hashed). Use the same canonical serialization bytes so a third party can reproduce the seed from scratch by hashing the persisted proposal_canon.json and then hashing hProposal concatenated with the same salt.
